nav.payroll_hint: Payslips each month, and what each person is owed
nav.my_pay_hint: What you're owed, and your payslips
hr.left_on_help: The last day worked. Needed when the status is "Left"; their last month is paid for the days up to it.
money.help.salary_paid: Salary paid to a staff member for a month. It lowers what the shop owes them; Payroll shows what's left for the month.
money.help.food_paid: Food allowance paid to a staff member. They earn it day by day (Settings → Payroll); this pays it out.
money.help.bonus_paid: One-off extra pay to a staff member, paid now. It isn't part of their salary.
money.help.staff_advance: Money given to a staff member ahead of their pay. They owe it back until it is taken from their salary.
money.help.staff_deduction: Takes an advance back from a staff member's pay. No money moves: what the shop owes them and the advance both go down.
money.help.shareholder_advance: Money given to a shareholder ahead of their salary. They owe it back until it is deducted.
money.help.shareholder_deduction: Takes a shareholder's advance back from their salary. No money moves; the advance goes down.
money.period_help: The month this salary is for.
money.no_staff: No staff yet. Add them in Staff.
val.over_advance: That's more than the advance still owed ({advance}).
val.no_salary: This person has no salary on their staff record.
pay.payslips_help: A draft follows attendance and leave until a shareholder issues it. Tap a person to see the figures.
pay.accounts_help: What the shop owes each person now (payslips and food allowance less what was paid), and any advance they owe back.
pay.nobody: Nobody with a salary was employed this month.
pay.opening_owed: What the shop owed them when the app started
pay.opening_help: Pay and food allowance still owed from before this app.
pay.cancel_help: A cancelled payslip can be issued again with new figures.
pay.issued: Payslip issued. The person can see it.
pay.unpaid_absent: Absent days to cut from pay
pay.unpaid_absent_help: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} absent without leave this month. Decide how many are unpaid; the rest are paid.
pay.this_month: Paid and given in this month
pay.nothing_paid: Nothing paid for this month yet.
pay.advance_to_return: Advance still to be taken from your pay: {amount}
pay.account_parts: Payslips {payslips} · food allowance earned {food} · salary paid {salary} · food allowance paid {food_paid} · deducted {deductions}
pay.set.divisor: A day's pay is the salary divided by
pay.set.divisor_help: Used for part months and unpaid days.
pay.set.food_skip_unpaid: Every day employed except unpaid leave
pay.set.food_worked: Only the days the person punched in
pay.set.rates_help: Each rate applies from its date until the next one. To change the rate, add a new date; earlier days keep their old rate.
pay.food_weeks: Food allowance by week (Saturday to Friday)
pay.unpaid_leave: Unpaid leave days to cut from pay
pay.unpaid_leave_help: {count} days of unpaid leave this month. Cut all, some or none of them.
pay.salary_change_help: The salary is the parts added up. A part without a name is just "salary".
val.before_joining: That is before the person joined.
val.payslip_issued: The payslip for {month} is already issued. Cancel it first to change the salary from then.
pay.set.month_start: The accounting month starts on day
pay.set.month_start_help: Payroll, payslips and month reports run from this day to the day before it next month. 1 is the calendar month.
pay.set.overdue_days: A salary is overdue this many days after its payslip is issued
money.field.instalment: Repaid in instalments of (Tk a month)
money.instalment_help: Leave empty to take it back all at once. Each month the instalment is suggested as a deduction.
